Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the demo request last week. We want to schedule a technical deep-dive with our Solutions Engineering lead (Dylan) and include HelioMed engineers and your security/procurement stakeholders so we can cover integration surface, runtime guarantees, and the compliance evidence you requested.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 17, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Nov 18, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Nov 19, 09:00–10:00

Agenda (draft):
- 10 min intros & success criteria
- 30 min live walkthrough: deployment, VPC options, monitoring
- 15 min security/compliance Q&A (SOC2, data isolation, logs)
- 5 min next steps / procurement checklist

I've attached a short agenda (SE_demo_agenda_v1.pdf). Can you confirm who from HelioMed will join (engineer + security + procurement) and which slot works? If none of the above fit, please propose two alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our manager Evelyn for any escalation/SLAs if needed.

Cheers,
